decision: one tier-1 fidelity finding confirmed (mauled); within the user ruling that fixes its wrong meaning, the host picks a wording that fits the “……而死” template; fix in execute-02, then RE_REVIEW(1,1).

findings.reason: 固定 commit 624a673 game/modules/tome/data/damage_types.lua:778（PHYSICAL death_message 表）：mauled 指被猛烈撕扯、扑咬重创致死；代入模板“……{词}而死”。本窗 execute-01 的“被撕咬致残”把致死原因限定为咬伤，且“致残”与“而死”语义冲突（伤残≠死亡）。用户 2026-09-29 裁决的是修正此条错义，具体措辞由宿主按模板定：改为“被撕碎”（同表 torn limb from limb＝被五马分尸、shattered＝被击碎，无重复）。
